title: Automated Deployment of Real-Time Tasks for Phased Execution on Scratchpad-Based Multicore Platforms
abstract: arXiv:2609.04221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The increasing throughput demands in real-time systems and the consolidation of functionality on few, high-performance platforms are driving a shift towards parallel architectures. A key challenge for multicore real-time systems is the interference from contention for access to shared memory. Phased execution approaches address this challenge by restricting shared memory access to mutually exclusive memory phases, while computation is limited to memories local to each core. However, the complexity of managing and scheduling said memory phases hinders the adoption of phased execution in real-time applications. To address this challenge, we propose a model-based deployment methodology that automates the process of adapting applications to phased execution. translated_title: 基于便签式存储器的多核平台上实时任务分阶段执行的自动化部署
translated_abstract: 实时系统中日益增长的吞吐量需求以及功能向少数高性能平台的整合，正在推动系统向并行架构转变。多核实时系统的一个关键挑战是共享内存访问争用所产生的干扰。分阶段执行方法通过将共享内存访问限制在互斥的内存阶段来应对这一挑战，同时将计算限制在每个核心本地的存储器中进行。然而，管理和调度这些内存阶段的复杂性阻碍了分阶段执行在实时应用中的采用。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于模型的部署方法，实现了应用程序向分阶段执行适配过程的自动化。我们提出了一个集成的基于工具的部署流程，该流程通过必要的内存阶段对应用程序进行扩展，并提供了一个运行时环境来协调执行。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模型的自动化部署方法与集成工具流程，能够自动将实时应用适配为分阶段执行模式，从而简化多核平台上内存阶段的管理与调度，缓解共享内存争用干扰问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a model-based automated deployment methodology with an integrated tool-based process that automatically adapts real-time applications to phased execution, simplifying memory phase management and scheduling to mitigate shared memory interference on multicore platforms.
